sources: scripts/clubhouse/perf-measure-run.mjs summarise and recorded run ranges
coverageNote: Only cases present in the supplied baseline are required by default. Home/Stats and the CoachHelm/Qualifiers/Rounds harnesses do not measure every Clubhouse family; add exact requiredCases to require wider coverage. Null INP is unknown: the observer omits interactions below 16ms and does not prove their duration.
regressionNote: Measured before-run range is the noise floor. A worsening median above one before-run spread warns; above two spreads fails. These are configurable noise multipliers, not fabricated millisecond baselines. Identical before runs have zero spread, so any positive worsening fails.
